agyos_skill.intent: The AI native file format. EXIF for AI — stamps every file with trust scores, source provenance, and compliance metadata. Embeds into 20+ formats (DOCX, PDF, images, code). EU AI Act, SOX, HIPAA auditing.
agyos_skill.instructions: Every photo has EXIF. Every song has ID3. AKF is the native metadata format for AI-generated content. Use this skill when you need to stamp, inspect, or audit provenance and trust metadata on AI-generated or AI-modified files for compliance, review, or handoff workflows. ```bash akf stamp <file> --agent <agent-name> --evidence "<what you did>" ``` Evidence examples: - "generated from user prompt" - "refactored existing code" - "tests pass" - "docs reviewed" ```bash akf read <file> # Check existing trust metadata akf inspect <file> # See detailed trust scores ``` ```bash akf audit <file> --regulation eu_ai_act # EU AI Act Article 50 akf audit <file> --regulation hipaa # HIPAA akf audit <file> --regulation sox # SOX akf audit <file> --regulation nist_ai # NIST AI RMF ``` - `--label confidential` for finance/secret/internal paths - `--label public` for README, docs, examples - Default: `internal` ```bash pip install akf
